The '''Jawa Canyon''' was one of many locations on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. It was here that in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] [[Dathcha/Legends|Dathcha]] shot [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]].
